svg.title: Axion Agent Studio — deployment and execution architecture
svg.desc: A browser submits a request to a regular N4A manager Pod. Hosted Gemini plans and summarizes work through Vertex AI. The manager dispatches to three gVisor sandbox Pods on one shared C4A virtual machine, each containing a worker API and local Gemma model server. Backend and frontend build in parallel, then QA generates tests. A separate N4A validator executes protected checks and generated tests, and serves accepted pricing calculations. Only passed validation enables the shop preview served by the manager. A separate C4A system node is shown. VM sizes describe provisioned capacity, not Pod limits.

g.text: c4a-standard-16 · 16 vCPUs shared by all three engineers
03 Tasks + scoped code ⇄ changes / tests · HTTP :8081
Candidate / test results / accepted pricing quotes
Protected checks + generated tests · gVisor Pod
Executes candidate Python and accepted pricing quotes
CPU capacity belongs to VMs. Each engineer Pod requests 4.25 CPUs, has a 6.5-CPU limit, and runs 4 inference threads.
Gemini plans. Arm executes. Independent checks gate the preview.
Recorded deployment topology · GKE control plane managed separately · No local GPU inference
